symptomShortText: Sensor mounts detaching in customer assembly

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-5120, Shift A - surface prep steps signed off complete
EQ-BOND02-001 dispenser volume within +/-2% of target all shift
DOC-8815 Rev B - bonding procedure, cure profile unchanged since 2025-08
Adhesive lot ADH-3391 within shelf life, viscosity and cert PASS
Pull tester GA-0355, last cal 2026-04-18, R&R 7.4%
Bonding cell relative humidity logged 78-84% RH across 2026-07-06 to 07-09 against a 45% RH maximum; the cell dehumidifier had tripped and was not restarted

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the sensor mounts detach?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Lap shear strength measured 4.1 MPa against a 12.0 MPa minimum, one third of the required bond strength

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the bond so weak despite correct adhesive and geometry?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Moisture on the bonding surfaces during cure inhibited cross-linking; cell humidity reached 84% RH against a 45% maximum

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was humidity allowed to run at 84% for four days?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The cell dehumidifier tripped on 2026-07-06 and was never restarted

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did nobody notice the dehumidifier had tripped? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The humidity alarm reported to a facilities dashboard that production does not monitor, and no interlock stops bonding when the cell is out of its environmental window

actions.actionText: Block all S22 stock bonded in the outage window and pull-test a sample from every pallet
Notify the customer and sort the 310 units already delivered
Restart and service the WC-BOND-02 dehumidifier, then re-qualify the cell with a bonded test panel
Route cell humidity alarms to the production andon and interlock the bonding station above 50% RH

fmeaLink.description: Reduced bond strength from humidity during cure

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Cross-referencing the defect window against facility alarm logs isolated the cause in one afternoon
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: A process-critical environmental alarm was routed to a dashboard nobody in production watches

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: S22 brackets bonded in WC-BOND-02 between 2026-07-06 and 07-09
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: S22 bonded before 07-06 or after 07-10 - WC-BOND-05 with a working dehumidifier
isIsNot.notes: Defect window matches the dehumidifier outage exactly, not the adhesive lot
